statement_nl: For every integer m >= 2 and every integer g >= 0, the number N(m, g) of numerical semigroups with multiplicity m and genus g satisfies N(m, g) <= N(m, g + 1).

domain_restrictions: m is an integer with m >= 2
g is an integer with g >= 0
g+1 is therefore an integer >= 1 (so genus value g+1 is within the stated integer domain)
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For all integers m >= 2 and all integers g >= 0, the counting function N(m,g) is monotonically nondecreasing in g with step size 1: N(m,g) <= N(m,g+1).

variables.name: m
variables.role: multiplicity parameter of numerical semigroups; universally quantified

variables.name: g
variables.role: genus parameter of numerical semigroups; universally quantified

variables.name: N(m,g)
variables.role: cardinality of the set of numerical semigroups with multiplicity m and genus g
